correctness.rationale: The exact representation u=tau[q-h+u0/tau]_+, mass conservation, and the Morse asymptotics G(s)=Cs^2+o(s^2) give C tau q^2->1. Independent sublevel-set asymptotics give phi~q/2 without differentiating an asymptotic equivalence, and Hessian scaling yields the local parabolic-cap profile and t^{-1/4} support law.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The source paper gives qualitative concentration and determinant weights but not the temporal rates or parabolic-cap dynamical profile. The closely related arXiv:2605.03553 stationary obstacle analysis is explicitly excluded from novelty; its elliptic support geometry and quartic radial profile concern a different regime.

value.rationale: The result sharpens the generic Morse-maxima case from a limit-measure description to explicit localization width, peak-height and multiplier-relaxation rates with a universal local profile, and it explains dynamically the determinant weights already observed in the source.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
